title: What Is an Account-Based Experience Strategy?
body_html:
Updated May 2024

By Folloze

In an era of increasing AI tools and fragmented data, B2B go-to-market teams often feel overwhelmed by the challenge of connecting insights to actionable campaigns. Many struggle with siloed execution, leading to inconsistent buyer experiences and inefficient handoffs across departments. This fragmentation hinders the ability to deliver relevant, personalized engagement across complex buying groups, risking pipeline credibility and slowing time-to-market.

TL;DR:

  • An account based experience strategy extends Account-Based Marketing (ABM) across the entire customer lifecycle, orchestrating personalized interactions for individual buyers.
  • It focuses on continuous, data-driven experiences, not disconnected campaigns run channel by channel.
  • Companies using AI orchestration platforms like Folloze launch campaigns 50% faster and achieve 10x engagement by centralizing signals and execution.

An account based experience strategy is a go-to-market approach that uses data and insights to orchestrate relevant, trusted marketing and sales actions throughout the B2B customer journey. This approach goes beyond traditional campaign planning by focusing on continuous, personalized interactions across the entire customer lifecycle, involving marketing, sales, and customer success.

What defines a modern ABX strategy?

A modern ABX strategy is defined by a comprehensive, buyer-centric approach that transcends traditional, channel-specific campaigns. It prioritizes understanding individual buyer behavior within target accounts, allowing for dynamic content delivery and personalized outreach. According to industry analysts, this integrated view, expanding beyond typical Account-Based Marketing (ABM) across the entire customer lifecycle, is crucial for sustained revenue growth.

This ABX strategy actively moves away from isolated email, ad, or website personalization projects. Instead, it emphasizes a unified, data-driven orchestration of experiences across all touchpoints, adapting in real-time. According to a recent B2B marketing study (2023), companies that adopt an orchestration mindset see a significant increase in pipeline velocity.

How does an ABX strategy address AI overwhelm?

An ABX strategy, especially when powered by AI orchestration, transforms AI overwhelm into practical, measurable execution. Instead of being paralyzed by data, teams use AI to connect content, campaigns, buyer signals, and revenue proof within a single operating layer. What are the core components of an ABX framework?

The core components of an effective ABX framework include data intelligence, dynamic personalization, and continuous measurement. It starts with comprehensive data collection, integrating intent, behavioral, and demographic insights across the buying group to inform highly personalized content and experiences. Platforms like Folloze simplify personalization, ensuring relevance across every interaction by enabling dynamic adjustments based on real-time buyer signals.

Measurement is integrated throughout, tracking individual engagement, account progression, and ultimately, pipeline and revenue impact. This allows for ongoing optimization and proves the value of the account based experience strategy to executive stakeholders. Microsoft saw 560 leads and $10M influenced pipeline by orchestrating campaigns.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between ABM and ABX?

Account-Based Marketing (ABM) typically focuses on generating pipeline and acquiring new target accounts, primarily driven by marketing efforts. Account-Based Experience (ABX) expands on ABM by extending the strategy across the entire customer lifecycle - from awareness through advocacy - and integrates marketing, sales, and customer success for a unified, continuous experience. It emphasizes orchestrating personalized experiences for individual buyers within those accounts.

How does AI fit into an ABX strategy?

AI is fundamental to modern ABX strategies, helping teams to orchestrate complex buyer journeys, analyze vast amounts of data, and personalize interactions at scale. AI tools can identify target accounts, predict buyer intent, dynamically adapt content, and automate campaign workflows. An AI orchestration platform like Folloze AI transforms these insights into actionable programs, ensuring relevance and efficiency "from prompt to pipeline."

Why is individual engagement critical for ABX success?

While account selection tells you where to focus, individual-level engagement tells you what to do next. Within any target account, multiple stakeholders form a buying group, each with unique needs and roles. Understanding and catering to individual behavior ensures that interactions are highly relevant, build trust, and drive consensus. RingCentral achieved 98% target account engagement and 50% C-suite engagement by focusing on individual buyer journeys.
